method: replicates base helper memory_gate(): ten GlobalMemoryStatusEx samples at 0.25 s spacing

CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.statement: The owner ruling says 'stop if the memory gate is not satisfied; do not use override'. That instruction CANNOT self-enforce in the current on-disk state: the memory gate is bypassed by a persistent write-once receipt file, not by a runtime flag.
CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.mechanism: F3R2_V5_NATIVE_LOOP1_IMPORT_ATTACH_ONLY.py:341 -> `if not mo.override_allowed() and not all(sample >= MIN_AVAILABLE_GIB ...)` . The same short-circuit repeats at line 470 inside audit_g0().
CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.override_origin_instruction: 不要管门限了开始就行 (2026-08-10)
CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.consequence: If Loop1E is launched as-is, memory_gate() will NOT raise AVAILABLE_RAM_HOLD at 2.1 GiB. It will record the samples and continue into SolidWorks. The 2026-08-20 ruling's precondition available_memory_gib_ge_6 would be silently unmet-but-unenforced.
CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.aggravating_factor: measured availability today (~2.1 GiB) is LOWER than the 4.55-4.69 GiB that prompted the original override, so the override is now being applied far outside the conditions under which it was granted
CRITICAL_FINDING_OVERRIDE_BYPASS_STILL_A.not_actioned_by_agent: the override receipt lives inside the frozen V5 directory and is a write-once authorization record; removing or editing it is an owner decision, not an agent action
owner_options: O1 (recommended): owner revokes the override for this round - rename/relocate V5_MEMORY_GATE_USER_OVERRIDE.json, or add a superseding revocation receipt the module honours, so the 6 GiB gate becomes self-enforcing again
O2: keep the override but free memory first so the real samples clear 6.0 GiB anyway, making the bypass moot
O3: explicitly re-authorize running at ~2 GiB, accepting the documented low-memory crash risk (2 prior memory-death events on this machine); NOT recommended
